notes.title: The Last Gas Station Announcement
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce our upcoming game — The Last Gas Station, a charming yet mysterious simulator about running the very last fuel stop in a world that’s moved on. 

You’ve just become the new owner of an old roadside gas station — complete with a tiny store, broken pumps, and a long-forgotten past. The previous owner vanished without a trace… and now it’s your turn to bring the place back to life. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596811/0d05964e15fc011476a653170c9f0fafa6efd7cf.png[/img]

Clear out the cobwebs, stock your shelves, pump gas, and greet weary travelers under the flickering neon lights. Expand your services, customize your station, and build a cozy haven for those who still wander these quiet roads. 

But when the sun goes down, strange things happen. 
 Locals say it’s best to stay inside after dark. The old owner didn’t. 

The Last Gas Station opens its doors soon. Wishlist now and prepare to pour coffee, sweep floors, and maybe… uncover the truth hiding in the shadows. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3690030/The_Last_Gas_Station/
